sutta: the next 55.2 the buddha said monks a noble disciple who possesses four things is a stream enterer sutapanna no longer bound to the nether world fixed in destiny the enlightenment as his destination but four here monks a noble disciple possesses confirmed confidence or unshakeable faith in the buddha the dhamma and the sangha he possesses the virtues dear to the noble ones aryans unbroken and blemished are leading to concentration a noble disciple monks who possesses these four things is a stream enter no longer bound to the netherworld fix in destiny with enlightenment as its destination this is what the blessed one said having said this the fortunate one the teacher further said those who possess faith and virtue confidence and vision of the dhamma in time arrived at the happiness grounded upon the holy life that's the end of the sudda yes and the person who possesses these four factors is considered a stream enter a sotapanna and he will never be reborn in the warfu planes and he's fixed in destiny enlightenment as his destination somewhere else it is said now that he has a maximum of seven more rebirths
